paragraphs.text: Sulli Valenco was a wojek Section Commander of the Ninth Section in 9999 Z.C., present during Agrus Kos 's retirement hearing. She was one of his ex-wives.

Valenco was nominated to replace Commander-General Vict Gharti , who wanted to retire on the last day of the tenth millennium. She was to be succeeded by shift captain Phaskin . It never came to any of these two things. Sometime before the Decamillennial, she was killed and replaced by a lupul , a fact that was revealed during the Decamillennial.
